title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - NumberRange
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/NumberRange. This class describes a range via a datatype property indicating the start of the range and another datatype property indicating the end of the range. Subclass of Thing (http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing, not itself translated in this candidate).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'NumberRange'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

unitCode.description: Unit of measure code (UN/CEFACT common code where applicable).

endOfRange.description: Property. This property indicates the end of a number range. Models saref:PropertyValue (core SAREF, not itself translated in this candidate): a value with its unit of measure.

unitCode.description: Unit of measure code (UN/CEFACT common code where applicable).

startOfRange.description: Property. This property indicates the start of a number range. Models saref:PropertyValue (core SAREF, not itself translated in this candidate): a value with its unit of measure.
